scripts.wgo: go generate && cross-env CLICOLOR_FORCE=1 LOG=ln wgo
scripts.air: go generate && cross-env CLICOLOR_FORCE=1 LOG=ln air
scripts.test: go generate && cross-env CLICOLOR_FORCE=1 LOG=ln go run .
scripts.build_docker: docker build --build-arg VERSION=${VERSION:-$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 | sed 's/^v//')} -t mchauge/mediamtx-path-viewer:stable .
scripts.build_docker_beta: docker build --build-arg VERSION=${VERSION:-$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 | sed 's/^v//')} -t mchauge/mediamtx-path-viewer:beta .
